checklist.name: Bank accounts
checklist.ask: Do you have money in a bank account?
checklist.amount: Roughly how much, across all of them?

checklist.name: MPF
checklist.amount: Roughly how much, all your MPF accounts together?
checklist.hint: The eMPF Platform shows every account. Leave out voluntary contributions you can withdraw now; they come next.

checklist.name: MPF voluntary contributions
checklist.ask: Any voluntary contributions your scheme lets you withdraw now?
checklist.hint: Your scheme’s rules say whether you can. TVC money can’t be withdrawn early.

checklist.name: Investments
checklist.ask: Any investments — shares, funds, an investing app?
checklist.amount: Roughly what are they worth today?

checklist.name: Home
checklist.ask: Do you own the home you live in?
checklist.amount: Roughly what would it sell for?

checklist.name: Mortgage
checklist.ask: Is there a mortgage on it?
checklist.amount: Roughly how much is left to pay?
checklist.hint: Your latest mortgage statement shows what’s outstanding.

checklist.name: Car
checklist.amount: Roughly what would it sell for?

checklist.name: Other loans
checklist.ask: Anything else you owe — a personal loan, a student loan or a card balance?
